# sonarqube_rule (Resource)

A custom rule created from a rule template. Name, description, parameters, severity and status change in place.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A custom rule created from a template rule.
resource "sonarqube_rule" "no_legacy_import" {
  custom_key           = "no_legacy_import"
  template_key         = "java:S124"
  name                 = "Do not use the legacy client"
  markdown_description = "Use `com.example.client.v2` instead."
  severity             = "MAJOR"
  type                 = "CODE_SMELL"
  params               = "regularExpression=com\\.example\\.legacy\\.;message=Use the v2 client"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custom_key` (String) Key of the custom rule within its repository.
- `markdown_description` (String) Rule description in Markdown.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `template_key` (String) Key of the template rule, e.g. `java:S124`.

### Optional

- `params` (String) Parameters as `key1=value1;key2=value2`.
- `prevent_reactivation` (String) Fail rather than reactivate a removed rule with the same key (`true`/`false`).
- `severity` (String) Severity.
- `status` (String) `READY` (default), `BETA` or `DEPRECATED`.
- `type` (String) `CODE_SMELL`, `BUG`, `VULNERABILITY` or `SECURITY_HOTSPOT`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Rule key, `<repository>:<custom_key>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_rule.example 'java:no_legacy_import'
```
